articles.headline: Mukesh Ambani's Jio Seeks Record $108 Billion Valuation
articles.brief: Reliance Jio has filed its red herring prospectus, aiming for a record-breaking $108 billion valuation in its upcoming Indian initial public offering, complete with special reservations for RIL shareholders.

articles.headline: Canada's Fairfax Buys Majority Stake in IDBI Bank
articles.brief: Fairfax has successfully acquired a majority stake in IDBI Bank for a massive $5.56 billion, marking a significant foreign investment milestone in India's banking sector.

articles.headline: American Electric Power to Invest $4B in Google Project
articles.brief: American Electric Power has announced a major $4 billion investment plan toward a fuel cell energy project designed to exclusively power Google's growing infrastructure needs.

articles.headline: Ukraine Claims SpaceX Hampers Drones Amid Fraying Ties
articles.brief: Ukrainian officials have expressed frustration, stating that SpaceX is hampering crucial military drone operations for both attack and defense as broader US-Ukraine relations experience strain.

articles.headline: Yemen's Houthis Strike Saudi Aramco HQ and Vow Attacks
articles.brief: Following a direct missile strike that damaged the top floors of Saudi Aramco's headquarters, Yemeni Houthi forces have vowed to launch further attacks on regional Saudi airports and oil installations.

articles.headline: Two Singaporean Ships Attacked in Strait of Hormuz
articles.brief: Maritime security reports confirm that two Singaporean ships have come under fire in the vital Strait of Hormuz, with one vessel sinking amid a severe onboard fire.

articles.headline: Mauritius Hit by Worst Unrest Since 1999 Amid Riots
articles.brief: Severe public anger over water shortages, rising living costs, and a controversial police shooting has plunged Mauritius into its worst series of riots since 1999.

articles.headline: US Lawmaker Criticizes India Over Voter Roll Deletions
articles.brief: Democratic Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal has voiced deep concerns regarding reports of India purging millions of citizens from voter rolls, backing non-violent protests against anti-democratic policies.

articles.headline: GSK Plans Major Restructuring with 1,217 Job Cuts in Belgium
articles.brief: Pharmaceutical giant GSK has unveiled a sweeping three-year restructuring plan that involves slashing up to 1,217 jobs at its operational sites across Belgium.

articles.headline: India Tightens Tax Regulations for Mauritius Investments
articles.brief: Indian tax authorities have tightened regulations under the double taxation avoidance agreement, granting officials powers to deny benefits if tax relief is found to be the sole motive.

articles.headline: West Indies Defeat India to Level T20 Series in Hyderabad
articles.brief: A brilliant century by Shai Hope combined with Keemo Paul's devastating five-wicket haul propelled the West Indies to a comprehensive victory over India, leveling the series.

articles.headline: Gold Drops Over 1% Amid Rising US Inflation Data
articles.brief: Gold prices fell more than one percent as hot consumer inflation readings out of the United States fueled higher market bets for upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
